name: Hoshina Nanaoto
source:
"And if it's okay, I'll have you sing a lot. There's no other light music club for newcomers to use~?"

High school 3rd-year.

She is the president of the light music club. She loves to sing and is an energetic girl who loves to have fun. She has a live performance with Hokuto and Minami, and she asks them to play a certain song.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/nitousei/]official website[/url]]
